text:
Priya: Heads-up: AcmeHealth's security team bumped our POC checklist. They want a filled CAIQ + a concise shared-responsibility table for Dedicated vs Private deployments. Key asks: BYOK/HSM specifics, encryption at rest, network isolation (VPC), audit logging/retention and export, incident response timelines, and contract triggers. POC will touch PHI, so BAA clarity is required. Need a draft to send by EOD tomorrow.

Jordan: I can put together CAIQ snippets. Quick confirm: Dedicated and Private support customer-managed KMS (BYOK). Hosted uses Redwood-managed KMS by default. HSM-backed keys are supported for Private/on-prem or Dedicated with contractual ops review and may require customer-provided HSM. Is that right?

Marta: I'll make the one-page shared-responsibility table once you drop the snippets. Make sure to indicate export paths (S3/EventHub) and retention defaults.

Alex: Looping in Legal for BAA/DPA language. Also need to know whether POC will run against synthetic PHI or redacted production. If real PHI, we must escalate the contract review.

Jordan: Confirming: Dedicated & Private = BYOK supported. For Private/on-prem, customers can bring HSMs (PKCS#11) and we integrate with standard KMS APIs. Hosted = Redwood-managed KMS (multi-tenant). HSM-backed keys require a contractual amendment and operational review (attestation may be required per customer).

sec-bot: Internal reference: CAIQ answer bank v1.4 https://internal.redwood/security/caiq-answers :lock:

Marta: First-pass CAIQ + shared-resp text below — keep comments inline, I'll convert to CSV/matrix after legal sign-off.

```
CCM-EN-01 (Encryption at rest):
- Redwood: All customer data encrypted at rest with AES-256. Hosted uses Redwood-managed KMS by default (multi-tenant). Dedicated and Private support BYOK via standard KMS integrations. HSM-backed keys (FIPS 140-2/3) supported in Private/on-prem; for Dedicated require contract + ops review.
- Customer: For Hosted, request Dedicated/Private for BYOK. For Dedicated/Private, supply KMS credentials or HSM details. Maintain control over key rotation if BYOK; coordinate rotation windows with Redwood.

CCM-EN-02 (Encryption in transit):
- Redwood: TLS 1.2+ for all transport; TLS 1.3 recommended. Mutual TLS (mTLS) available for Private deployments when requested.

CCM-ID-01 (Identity & Access Mgmt):
- Redwood: Service-side RBAC, least-privilege, periodic credential rotation, and role auditing. Access to customer data by Redwood staff follows Just-In-Time (JIT) elevation and is logged.
- Customer: Manage end-user identities, IdP configuration (SAML/OIDC), and SSO/MFA policies. Customer responsible for onboarding/offboarding their users.

CCM-LO-01 (Logging & Monitoring):
- Redwood: Application and infra logs collected; default audit log retention 90 days on Hosted. Audit log export available for Dedicated within 24 hours to customer-managed storage (S3/EventHub). Extended retention as add-on.
- Customer: Configure ingestion/retention on their exported storage; for Private, manage local log retention policies.

CCM-IR-01 (Incident Response):
- Redwood: Maintains IR program aligned with SOC2. We notify customers within 2 hours of a confirmed breach impacting customer data. For Hosted incidents we lead containment; for Private/on-prem, customer leads local containment and coordinates with Redwood.

Shared responsibility highlights (sample rows):
- Network isolation: Redwood provides service network configs; customer configures VPC peering, security groups, and NSGs.
- Backups: Redwood handles encrypted service metadata backups. Customers are responsible for exporting application data backups if needed by policy.

Contract/Procurement flags:
- BYOK/HSM: requires contract amendment and ops onboarding.
- PHI/BAA: BAA required for PHI in POC/Prod; escalate to Legal.
- Data residency/sovereignty: SOW/region-lock required for strict residency guarantees.
```

Priya: This looks solid. Two tweaks: add a line that Hosted audit exports are available upon request but may take up to 72h; and call out that HSM attestation details are available under contract.

Jordan: Updated: Hosted audit exports upon request (up to 72h). HSM attestation is a contract-level deliverable; noted. Marked BAA and BYOK/HSM as legal items.

Marta: I'll assemble CAIQ CSV, the one-page table, and attach SOC2 + ISO certs. Draft short cover email for AcmeHealth security contact. Legal to handle the BAA send. Who will send the tech package?

Alex: Sales can send the CAIQ + shared table + certs to the customer's security team. Legal will add BAA and contract notes. Priya, Jordan, CC legal on the send.

Jordan: I'll package and upload to secure share and send to AcmeHealth security contact in ~15m, CC'ing Legal and Priya. :thumbsup:
